about: Hand corrections for the manager game's squads, for what the API gets wrong or late (a player back from a loan, a signing it has not listed). Each entry puts one player in one club. player: his name as the API spells it, or id: his API id. club: the club, by name. A player the API does not know at all also needs pos (GK CB LB RB DMF CMF AMF LMF RMF LWF RWF SS CF), and may have dob (YYYY-MM-DD), nat and no. out: YYYY-MM-DD makes him injured until then. name: the name he goes by, where the API's differs. ovr: his overall, set by hand. remove: true takes him out of the game. note: for you. Checked against the clubs' own squad lists on 11 November 2026.
